atoms.a: Hey Lola, do you think you seem like the same person around different people?
atoms.b: Hey Lola, do you ((think)) you seem like the same person around different people?

atoms.a: That is an interesting question, Matt... I would have to think about that. Why do you want to know?
atoms.b: That is an ((interesting)) question, Matt. I would have to think about that. Why do you want to know?

atoms.a: I noticed that my friend Mo seems like a totally different person around his football friends compared to when he is just around me. I wonder if that is true for me as well.
atoms.b: I noticed that my ((friend)) Mo seems like a totally different person around his football friends compared to when he is just around me. I wonder if that is ((true)) for me as well.

instruction.text: Welches Bild beschreibt Matts Situation am besten?

atoms.a: So, their dynamic is completely different to Mo's and mine when we are alone.
atoms.b: So, their dynamic is completely different to Mo's and mine when we are ((alone)).

atoms.a: You know what, I recognise that phenomenon in my brother. He acts differently around his friends than with me. Isn't that pretty normal?
atoms.b: You know what, I recognise that phenomenon in my brother. He acts differently around his friends than with me. Isn't that pretty ((normal))?

atoms.a: Maybe, but it makes me feel a little insecure. Does he like me less than his other friends? Am I less cool to him?
atoms.b: Maybe, but it makes me feel a little insecure. Does he like me ((less)) than his other friends? Am I less cool to him?

atoms.a: I think quite the opposite. He might be trying to be cool around his teammates, whereas he feels like he can just be himself around you.
atoms.b: I think quite the opposite. He might be trying to be cool around his teammates whereas he feels like can just be ((himself)) around you.

instruction.text: Wer kann wie charakterisiert werden? Wähle aus.

atoms.a: I have not looked at it from that perspective. You might be right.
atoms.b: I have not looked at it from that ((perspective)). You might be right.

atoms.a: And as for you: You might change the way you act around different people. But we all have different social identities. It's definitely not a bad character trait.
atoms.b: And as for you: You might change the way you act around different people. But we all have different social identities. It's definitely not a bad ((character)) trait.

atoms.a: Thank you, Lola, that helps a lot!
atoms.b: Thank you, Lola, that helps a lot!
